text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the eve of the Tenno Sho (Spring). 
Together with Orfevre, we made our clear 
intention to run in the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe known to the fans.
choice_data_list:
We're eyeing the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
this year.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, so that's how it is...! This is 
wonderful news!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Having become a Triple Crown Umamusume 
and now standing at the pinnacle of this 
era, the fans have eagerly awaited 
Orfevre-san's challenge!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed, that would be so.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
By royal decree. Make My will known far 
and wide.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"And we shall gather our subjects in the 
ancient capital."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"The crown rests upon my head. Next is—the 
Spring Shield."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Orfevre had hoped, her will was 
widely conveyed... and Kyoto Racecourse 
was filled with bright anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
—We really came all the way to Kyoto! 
Well, there's no way we could miss seeing 
Lady Orfevre as she is right now!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's been a long time since I felt 
like this... like I can't even imagine 
losing.

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
I know Orfevre will put on the greatest 
performance possible! And beyond that, the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart thumps at the expectant voices 
filling the venue. I don't feel pressure 
anymore; domestically, Orfevre is 
invincible.
choice_data_list:
Let's use today's victory to rally even 
more public support!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It might just be my imagination, but 
Orfevre seems quieter than usual..."
choice_data_list:
(It's not that she's being moody... 
right?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I think back to the Junior Class... 
Because she struggled with running alone, 
I created an environment where she could 
train by herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That in itself was a success, and Orfevre 
rarely loses her motivation just from 
being alone.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: None.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre answered without hesitation. She 
manages her physical condition 
meticulously... in which case, she might 
simply be at ease.
choice_data_list: I see. Well then... have a good time!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Orfe this, Orfe that... I mean, 
sure, she totally wrecked me in the Arima 
Kinen, but still.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm saying don't underestimate me!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Sure is.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wah! You scared me... Sorry, I didn't 
notice you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Can't be helped. That's just the kind 
of girl I am."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's dark. ...You good? ...Wait, 
now is not the time to be saying that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nail check! Need to do one last 
touch-up...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though... I don't want to give up 
either."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Why did I come here? Why—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—I can't help chasing after them. After 
that girl...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfeeeeevre!! Give us that masterful 
victory, just like always...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —...Do not despair.
